w10_T4_002722: Kwame bought 34 packs of trading cards and gave 18 of them to his sister Amara, who was left holding more packs than he had kept. Each pack Kwame still has holds 8 sheets. Every sheet has 6 pockets on it. Each pocket holds 8 cards. How many cards does Kwame have?
w10_T4_002726: Lin sowed 9 rows of sunflowers with 63 seeds in every row. Her brother Theo sowed exactly the same number of seeds in his own field, so the 2 of them put the same amount into the ground. A garden club then donated 78 extra seeds to the pair. Mice ate 163 of all those seeds before they could sprout. Their village has 40 houses. How many seeds were left to grow?
w10_T4_002728: A pharmacy had 60 boxes of vitamin tablets and sold 37 boxes during the week. It sent 7 more boxes back to the supplier because the labels were wrong. The pharmacy has stood on the high street since 1988. Every box still on the shelf holds 5 packets, each packet holds 2 sachets, and each sachet contains 6 tablets. How many tablets are on the shelf?
w10_T4_002730: A cinema archive held 105 film reels, and 19 of them were too damaged to keep. Each reel that survived carries 3 short films. A hard drive in the office holds another 14 short films. The projector in the main screen was installed 22 years ago, and the archive lists all its running times in minutes rather than in hours. A studio then reclaimed 96 of the short films. How many short films does the archive have?
w10_T4_002731: A market trader had 67 crates of oranges and sold 23 of them before noon. He then tripled the number of crates he was holding by buying from a wholesaler. A rival took 32 crates off his hands, and a farmer delivered 34 more. Every crate holds 6 kilograms of oranges, and the trader weighs his stock in kilograms rather than in tonnes. A late delivery added 77 kilograms of loose oranges to the same van. How many kilograms of oranges are in his van?
w10_T4_002733: On Monday morning a mill ran 9 looms, and each loom wove 107 metres of ribbon. Before lunch a supplier delivered another 27 metres of the same ribbon. In the afternoon every metre in the mill was cut into 6 short strips. A worker found 36 more strips left over from Friday and added them to the pile. That evening a shop bought 848 strips, and a wholesaler collected another 1190. How many strips were left in the pile?
w10_T4_002746: Priya stacked 132 boxes onto each of 4 trolleys and wheeled them all into the same bay. Her colleague Ben then doubled that stack by bringing in exactly as many boxes again, which was more than Priya had moved all week. A returns lorry added 69 boxes, and a supplier added another 71 to the same bay. Each box in the bay contains 8 folded shirts. How many shirts are in the bay?
w10_T4_002750: At the start of Monday a food bank had 111 parcels ready on the racks. During the morning volunteers packed 80 more, and before lunch a supermarket sent in 51. In the afternoon a school collection added 62 parcels. That evening 34 parcels were driven out to families. Late at night a bakery van dropped off 72 more parcels. How many parcels does the food bank have now?
w10_T4_002757: A theatre had 137 costumes in store, a wardrobe sale added 68, and a closing production donated 61 more. A touring company then borrowed 221 costumes. Each costume left in the store needs 4 repairs before the new season. Every repair takes 9 minutes, and the wardrobe team records its work in minutes rather than in hours. The theatre seats 500 people. How many minutes of repair work does the store need?
w10_T4_002763: A wildlife park has 3 aviaries, and each aviary holds 63 birds. Every bird eats 9 grams of seed each day. The keepers add another 39 grams a day for the chicks in the nursery. A dozen keepers work at the park over the summer. The feed is weighed in grams rather than in kilograms, and the head keeper needs the total for a trip lasting 4 days. How many grams of seed are needed for those 4 days?
w10_T4_002768: A cobbler had 20 pairs of laces in his drawer and used 18 pairs on Monday's repairs. A supplier delivered 63 pairs on Tuesday. A closing-down shop sold him 55 pairs, and a market stall added another 71 pairs. Half of the drawer is taken up by tins of polish. The shop opens at 8 every morning. How many pairs of laces are in the drawer?
w10_T4_002774: A vineyard had 176 rows of vines and grubbed up 48 rows that were diseased. In the spring it planted 65 new rows. Every row on the estate carries 5 vines. Each of those vines produced 8 bunches of grapes this year. The estate keeps 2 tractors in the barn. A single old vine by the gate gave another 79 bunches. How many bunches of grapes did the vineyard get?
w10_T4_002776: A school had 190 exercise books in the cupboard and sent 170 of them to a partner school. Every book still in the cupboard has 7 blank pages left in it. A teacher added 40 loose pages from a spare pad to the same cupboard. Half the class was away with flu that week. The school counts this stock in single pages rather than in books, and each page holds 3 exercises. How many exercises can the cupboard's pages hold?
w10_T4_002777: Early on Saturday morning a bakery shared 219 kilograms of flour equally among its 3 branches. During the morning the High Street branch took in 47 more kilograms from a supplier, and at midday a neighbour returned 34 kilograms. In the afternoon a wholesaler delivered 70 kilograms to that same branch. That evening the branch used 198 kilograms baking for a wedding. The bakery weighs its flour in kilograms rather than in grams. How many kilograms of flour does the High Street branch have left?
w10_T4_002784: On Monday morning Aled had 32 planks in the workshop and used 20 of them on a staircase. The planks that were left were shared equally among the 4 workbenches, and Aled took the share at his own bench. In the afternoon he cut each of his planks into 4 shelves, more shelves than his apprentice Cerys managed all day. Cerys then filled every shelf he had made with 9 books. That evening a trolley brought 80 more books into the workshop. How many books are in the workshop?
w10_T4_002785: A jam maker filled 6 crates with 92 jars in each crate. The jars were shared equally among the company's 3 shops, and the station shop took its share. Every jar in the station shop holds 7 spoonfuls of jam. Half of those jars are strawberry and the rest are apricot. The shop has been trading for 40 years. A bakery next door then used 637 spoonfuls from the shop's jars. How many spoonfuls of jam are left in the station shop?
w10_T4_002795: A charity shop began the month with 57 books on its shelf. A house clearance added 37 books, and a reading group donated another 47. A book fair then took 140 books away. A local author gave the shelf 65 of her own books. Every book on the shelf was sold for 5 dollars, and the shop spent 30 dollars of the takings on new carrier bags. How many dollars did the shop have left?
w10_T4_002796: A stationery factory puts 35 pins into every packet. Each box holds 4 packets, each carton holds 5 boxes, each pallet holds 5 cartons, and each shipping container holds 8 pallets. The ship that sailed on Tuesday carried 6 identical containers. The dock has 12 cranes along the quay. Half of the pins are gold coloured. How many pins were on the ship?
w10_T4_002798: A theatre sold 37 tickets on Monday and another 80 on Tuesday. Every one of those tickets cost 8 dollars. The programme stall took 65 dollars and the raffle added 77 dollars to the same pot. The theatre has 250 seats in the stalls, and the box office counts its takings in dollars rather than in cents. The tour visited 8 towns, and every town took exactly that same amount. How many dollars did the tour take altogether?
w10_T4_002799: A council nursery grew 151 young trees and bought 47 more from a supplier. Every one of those trees was planted together with 3 shrubs. Each shrub was grown from 3 cuttings taken the year before. The nursery van makes 5 trips a week. All of those cuttings were counted and shared equally among the 6 parks in the town. How many cuttings went to one park?
w10_T4_002800: Ana counted 162 sacks of rice in the store, and her colleague Bo added 14 sacks, fewer than the 25 sacks a lorry brought in later that day. Every sack in the store is split into 9 bags. Each bag fills 9 cups. Every cup holds 9 spoonfuls of rice. A cook then found 56 loose spoonfuls in a jar and added them to the count. How many spoonfuls of rice does the store hold?
w10_T4_002801: Maya keeps her money in a wallet and counts it in dollars rather than in cents. She started the week with 21 dollars. Her weekend job paid her 67 dollars. She spent 2 dollars on a bus fare and then found 6 dollars in an old coat pocket. On Sunday she paid 55 dollars towards a new bicycle. How many dollars are in her wallet now?
w10_T4_002808: On Saturday morning a garden centre had 101 trays of bulbs on display. The staff destroyed 12 trays that had gone mouldy in the rain. During the afternoon 81 trays were sold to customers. Half of the car park was closed for resurfacing that day. Every tray still on display in the evening holds 5 pots, and each pot contains 6 bulbs. How many bulbs were still on display?
w10_T4_002814: Ines packed 8 boxes with 194 nails in each box. Her apprentice Tomas added 3 nails he had found on the floor, a tiny contribution next to hers. A roofer then bought 523 nails from the boxes. Every nail still in the boxes will be fitted with 3 washers. The workshop is 45 years old. How many washers will be needed?
w10_T4_002818: A community radio station had 201 minutes of interviews recorded and deleted 181 minutes that were unusable. A guest added 76 minutes of new material, and a jingle added 3 minutes more. The station lists its output in minutes rather than in hours. For the anniversary week the producer tripled the length of the whole programme by repeating it with fresh links. How many minutes long is the anniversary programme?
